simple.meaning: עַם (ʻam) appears 1870 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, beginning at Genesis 11:6. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, covenant, kingship, city, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עַם (H5971) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows עַם through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: עַם (ʻam) / H5971 is tracked through Genesis 11:6, Genesis 14:16, Genesis 17:14, Genesis 17:16. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.short: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants ; figuratively, a flock
